actual_limiting_homogeneous_response.equation: Hsecond=D_H(u)*H, H0=1,Hprime0=0; l=0 in the exact limit
actual_limiting_homogeneous_response.scope: Full time-dependent limiting k=0 equation, not a frozen diagonal or a finite-k spectral statement
actual_limiting_homogeneous_response.state_control: Zero heavy data give the exact zero homogeneous solution; growth is not compulsory for all states

domain.finite_background_existence: Sufficiently small positive epsilon depending on each fixed forward interval [0,L]
domain.matter: Positive canonical null source with a locally reconstructed potential for each finite member; density/potential may be negative
domain.mode: Exact fixed-charge k=0 relative tensor, J=0,l0=0,H0=1,Hprime0=0; unit normalized linear column
domain.physical_frame: Pinned +--- composite g_eff, physical u=m*T, Ae(0)=1; not original CD/M1 frame
domain.time_direction: u>=0 only for the explicit orbit bounds; not a two-sided bounce-duration theorem

fixed_interval_convergence.background: Analytic scaled vector field on a compact positive-root tube; error <=B_L*epsilon*(exp(K_L*L)-1)/K_L
fixed_interval_convergence.canonical: Regularized kinetic/coefficient jets are analytic on the same tube despite f_relative=O(epsilon)
fixed_interval_convergence.mode: Matched J=0 canonical data give (H,Hprime,l)->(H_limit,Hprime_limit,0), O_L(epsilon)
fixed_interval_convergence.not_computed: Numerical tube/propagator bounds, epsilon_*(L), or an estimate on growing intervals
fixed_interval_convergence.physical: Composite projection and required time derivatives converge on the same fixed interval
fixed_interval_convergence.quantifiers: For each fixed finite L and tolerance, sufficiently small positive epsilon gives regular finite backgrounds and uniform convergence on [0,L]

general_fixed_scaling_screen: At a centre with fixed eta0>0,a0>=0, v0=sqrt(1+eta0/3)>1 and N_R-(3/4)m_alg^2=[3(a0+1)^2+v0^2(3v0-2)]/(4v0^2)>0
not_established: A regular two-metric geometry at epsilon=0
Finite-Y all-time instability, a nonlinear instability, or growth for every initial state
A uniform finite-amplitude physical two-metric perturbation family for H0=1
A bound on a CD-duration or logarithmically growing window, or an interchange of Y and time limits
A finite-k gap, dispersion relation, vector/scalar health, cutoff, ghost or ultraviolet verdict
A general exclusion of nonadiabatic finite-band light-only reductions or other HR states/actions
A globally free old M1 matter action or original CD/M1 physical-frame matching
Completion of S6, P8(b), or P8

physical_projection.initial_tidal_jet: gamma_eff_second(0)=-20sqrt(2)/M in u time, nonzero physical linearized tidal curvature

singular_limit_and_amplitude_guard.individual_geometry: N_g and a_g vanish as epsilon->0; endpoint is not a regular two-metric parent solution
singular_limit_and_amplitude_guard.normalized_column: H0=1 implies relative metric delta=H/f_relative=O(1/epsilon), not uniform small metric amplitude
singular_limit_and_amplitude_guard.scalar_clock: Positive at finite epsilon but degenerates in the limit; no uniform reconstructed-potential derivative bounds
singular_limit_and_amplitude_guard.small_metric_family: Multiply the linear column by epsilon*epsilon_lin on a fixed interval; relative metrics remain small and absolute composite amplitude tends to0
singular_limit_and_amplitude_guard.surviving_statement: Normalized linear growth ratios and tidal derivatives, not finite nonlinear instability or unsuppressed absolute response at fixed small metric amplitude

verification_boundary: Written positivity/comparison/compact-Gronwall proofs plus exact source/ODE/canonical/Fraction identities and independent audits; not Lean formalized, no numerical finite-Y threshold
